mapper.insert: INSERT INTO change_history (entity_name, entity_key, operation_type, before_value, after_value, changed_by, changed_at, change_reason, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{entityName}, #{entityKey}, #{operationType}, to_jsonb(#{beforeValue}::text), to_jsonb(#{afterValue}::text), #{changedBy}, now(), #{changeReason}, 'ACTIVE', now(), now())
